text:
maria: heads up — planning to onboard tidal-12b to hosted + dedicated tomorrow. want to run a smoke -> canary -> cascade rollout. TL;DR checklist below, need owners and gating criteria. ping @sam for infra, @jin for quant/eval, @elaine for monitoring.
jin: thanks. initial experiments: FP16 baseline on A100, int8 dynamic looks promising but need qual eval on our eval set (conversational + summarization). I'll run 1k prompt pairs overnight.
sam: infra notes: dedicated capacity needs 8xA10G for steady throughput; hosted canary on small pool. I'll provision canary pool and set autoscale min=1 max=4.
maria: key gating criteria suggestion:
- pass eval regression delta <= 0.5 BLEU/ROUGE on summarization
- hallucination rate <= baseline + 1%
- latency p95 <= 450ms on hosted canary
- no memory OOMs for sequences up to 8k tokens
jin: agree. also add embedding drift check for downstream search -- sample 10k embeddings compare cosine mean shift < 0.02.
elaine: monitoring dashboards to create:
- per-model latency (p50/p95), error rate, OOM count
- quality drift hooks (daily eval job)
- cost per token estimate and tail-latency alert
I'll add panels and alerts.
maria: rollout plan (high level):
1) smoke (internal dev only, 5% traffic to canary pool) — 30m
2) canary (public, 1% production traffic) — 1-2h
3) cascade (gradually increase to 20% over 6h with step increases & metrics check)
4) full (switch; keep shadowing baseline for 24h)
include automated fallback to baseline model on any alert for 5min
sam: canary config snippet:
```
route:
  - name: tidal-12b-canary
    capacity: 0.01
    pools: [canary-12b]
    fallback: raven-13b-v1
healthchecks:
  - p95_latency_ms: 450
  - error_rate_pct: 0.5
```
jin: quant experiments:
- int8 static vs int8 dynamic vs int4 hybrid (try int4 kv-cache preserved)
- run 5000-token rolling window with KV cache warmup metrics
- golden prompts for safety/regression
maria: owners:
- infra/canary provisioning: sam
- quant + eval suite: jin
- dashboards + alerts: elaine
- rollout coordination + decision: maria
ops-bot: deploy-bot started canary pool provisioning (job id: cb-9876). ETA ~12m.
sam: provisioning done. canary pool ready at canary-12b. loadgen script in repo: link to internal repo -> scripts/loadgen --model tidal-12b --qps 5 --duration 30m
jin: I pushed eval run 1/3: embedding drift 0.013, rouge delta +0.3, hallucination +0.6% (just above threshold). I'll run safety scrub and targeted prompt set to see if hallucination spikes are pattern-based.
maria: OK flag: hallucination +0.6% > 0.5% gate. We hold canary public rollout until jin investigates. Sam pause traffic increase.
jin: found culprit: one temperature setting default was 0.9 in sampling layer for canary build. Re-running at 0.7 yields hallucination +0.2%. re-pushing new model build.
ops-bot: deploy-bot deployed model tidal-12b-v2 (build 20260321-17). smoke canary switched.
elaine: dashboards show p95 410ms, errors 0.2%, cost +8% vs baseline. I'll watch drift hooks.
maria: proceeding to canary -> start increasing to 1% traffic in 15m, step to 5% then 10% with metric checks between steps. Keep rollback window 10m after each step.
sam: ack. will auto-revert to raven-13b-v1 on alert. :thumbsup: 
jin: final note — we still need to run quant int8 static overnight and compare perplexity and human eval for safety prompts. I'll post results tomorrow.
maria: thanks y'all. I'll update the runbook and mark owners. :rocket:
